title: YOUHAN ONE independent review record
description: One review of one execution session. Separation of duty is checked structurally: the reviewing actor must differ from the executing actor, and the reviewing session must not be the reviewed session. See docs/sdd/AGENT_ROLE_MODEL.md on what that does and does not prove.

reviewId.description: Must match the file name without the .json suffix. SDD-V050.

sessionId.description: The execution session under review. It must exist; SDD-V055 rejects a review of a session that does not.

reviewerSessionId.description: The reviewing session, when the review itself ran as a session. Must differ from sessionId. SDD-V051.

actorId.description: Must differ from the reviewed session's actorId. SDD-V051.

decision.description: An engineering review decision. It is not a human approval gate and never discharges one.

satisfiesHumanGate.description: Whether this review discharges a gate that requires a human. SDD-V053 rejects true when actorType is ai. An agent must never set this.
